meanings.note: бывший мэр = the former mayor; бывшая жена = ex-wife
the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
He likes to help himself to public funds.
It was a good budget hotel.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: иметь в виду = to mean, to have in mind

examples.text: Из окна красивый вид на парк.
examples.trans: There is a nice view of the park from the window.

meanings.note: оказывать влияние на = to exert influence over

examples.text: Но на неё у нас влияния нет.
examples.trans: But we have no influence over her.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

examples.trans: The money is on the table.

заняться.gloss: to attend to, take care of, engage in

meanings.en: to attend to, occupy oneself with
meanings.note: + instrumental: заняться деньгами = to take care of the money

examples.trans: I will take care of this question tomorrow.
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: mostly in set phrases: иметь совесть, иметь право = to have the right; everyday 'I have' is у меня есть

examples.trans: You have the right to remain silent.
